description: Change a staff member's share of bookings (weight) or the opening hours they work for one service. With no staff member chosen, a booking goes to whoever is free with the fewest upcoming bookings for their weight, so weight 2 gets about twice as many as weight 1. For multi-step Replo work, read the replo skill (call skills with name "replo").

projectId.description: The project that owns the forms, from list_projects

scheduleId.description: Moves this staff member to other opening hours

staffId.description: The staff member's id, from the service's staff list

weight.description: Share of bookings when the visitor doesn't pick: a host with weight 2 gets about twice as many as one with weight 1

name: replo_booking_staff_update
title: Update a service's staff member
